CloudStrmHelper.name: CloudStrm
CloudStrmHelper.description: Monitor a CD2-mounted China Mobile cloud disk without an official API, generate OpenList STRM files, sync subtitles and sidecar files, then refresh Emby.
CloudStrmHelper.author: Felix Yang

history.V1.6.0: Replaced dead dashboard placeholders with real controls (task refresh, save/discard, strategy switches, extension removal, full scan), kept a permanent add-rule form, fixed legacy rule migration, prune counting, task notification titles, and isolated per-media notification errors; removed unused legacy code.
history.V1.5.9: Unified the settings page and dashboard UI with shared GitHub-dark tokens: page and card colors, 15px titles, 16px card padding and gaps, consistent input, switch, button, and category-tag sizing, plus a settings header with status and task action.
history.V1.5.8: Existing mapping rules are now displayed as fully expanded inline forms, with the reference dark-blue palette, tighter 12px labels, 14px input text, and consistent spacing. The add editor remains on demand.
history.V1.5.7: The mapping-rule editor now stays hidden until Add Mapping Rule is clicked. The toolbar button reveals and expands the one blank editor, while existing rules remain separately collapsible.
history.V1.5.6: Restored the mapping-rule table and the always-available add editor. The add button now expands the editor using MoviePilot's stable form state handling, and existing rules remain editable and removable before saving.
history.V1.5.5: Fixed mapping-rule creation: the add control now inserts a new editable rule row, redundant default add panels were removed, and the mapping editor typography and spacing were refined.
history.V1.5.4: Refined the configuration workflow to match the latest reference: a compact mapping overview precedes one default-open add editor, sidecar and subtitle copying use one unified switch, and low-frequency path, execution, and cleanup options are folded away.
history.V1.5.3: Improved the configuration form to match the SVG layout more closely: mapping rules now have a dedicated add editor, existing rules can be marked for deletion and are compacted on save, and the new-rule editor opens by default.
history.V1.5.2: Reworked the configuration page around the latest SVG: all workflow sections are visible, mappings render as a compact column summary, and individual rule fields expand only when needed.
history.V1.5.1: Fixed the task-page crash caused by a missing pending-deleted-mapping helper. Pending mapping deletions now render safely and preserve duplicate-rule state until configuration is saved.
history.V1.4.4: Reworked the mapping rules panel into a table layout matching the latest SVG design: aligned columns for category tags, CD2 mount dir / STRM output dir, OpenList cloud dir and format template, a per-rule monitor toggle, plus edit/delete actions.
history.V1.4.0: Rebuilt the dashboard to fully match the reference mockup with working controls: staged strategy toggles (realtime watch, scheduled incremental scan, cloud prune), save/discard config flow, mapping rules with delete and pending state, removable extension chips, KPI cards with a persisted prune counter, a bottom-anchored live event terminal, and a new scheduled incremental scan job. Mapping rules are now edited as structured cards in settings, with legacy text configs auto-migrated.
history.V1.4.3: Optimized the monitor page and task history: task summaries no longer deep-copy file details, task detail API paginates without loading all items, history keeps full details only for recent tasks and failed records for older tasks, remote mount checks run in a background cache so the page never blocks on WebDAV/FUSE, mapping rules use an explicit add card with fully custom categories, and per-file info logs were reduced to debug level.
history.V1.3.1: Refined the CloudStrm dashboard to match the provided SVG mockup: header status bar, 4/8 split layout, KPI mini cards, strategy switches, mapping row cards with hover actions, and a 180px live log terminal.
history.V1.3.0: Redesigned the task center around an OpenList + CD2 monitoring console for no-API mobile cloud disks: monitoring mode, path mapping, STRM totals and recent sync details.
history.V1.2.1: Fixed task detail and dashboard tables rendering empty: MoviePilot's page renderer always injects a default slot, which suppresses VDataTable's built-in header/body, so tables now render as lightweight HTML.
history.V1.2: Polished task center UI: color-coded statuses, consolidated task list, always-visible details, auto-expanding config sections, new icon.
history.V1.1: Added task center history, per-file results, completion summaries, failure details, and selective retries.
history.V1.0: Initial release with directory monitoring, full scan, STRM generation, subtitle and sidecar sync, and Emby refresh.
history.V1.4.1: Fixed dashboard layout and interaction issues: right-column cards now stretch to equal height so the live log terminal fills remaining space, task stats use uniform metric tiles, recent tasks use a fixed-column aligned grid, page scrolling is stable with scrollbar-gutter, and mapping rule categories are editable as chip tags via VCombobox.
history.V1.4.2: Fixed plugin page load failure: stale CloudStrmCompanion class references in category helpers caused get_page to raise NameError on MoviePilot v2/v3.

CloudStrmButler.name: 云盘Strm小管家
CloudStrmButler.description: 实时监控云盘目录，增量生成 STRM 文件，复制字幕和旁车文件，并刷新 Emby。
CloudStrmButler.author: Felix Yang

history.2.1.5: 修复配置保存后未真正持久化或重新打开恢复默认的问题：以 MoviePilot 已保存配置为准、保存后回读校验，并用宿主返回值刷新界面。
history.2.1.4: 修复配置保存必须调用 MoviePilot 宿主接口；修正可靠同步处理中数量统计，并为 NAS/FUSE I/O 超时增加可重试失败处理。
history.2.1.3: 修复 Vue 配置保存：兼容 reactive 配置序列化、结构化路径规则保存、旧版 monitor_confs 迁移和宿主 API 响应格式。
history.2.1.1: 修复可靠同步状态页请求接口大小写不一致导致的 404。
history.2.1.0: 可靠同步：可恢复任务队列、失败重试、扫描缺失文件二次确认清理、Emby 批量刷新与状态页面。
history.2.0.2: 兼容旧版 $nomonitor 规则，保持其在 Vue 配置页中的关闭状态；补充接口回归测试。
history.2.0.1: 修复 MoviePilot v3 抽象接口缺失导致的插件实例化失败，并补齐 get_service/get_api 实现。
history.2.0.0: Vue 联邦配置界面：目录规则改为动态增删输入框，支持自定义分类标签，并兼容旧版 monitor_confs 配置。
history.1.0.0: 首个版本：目录监控、全量/增量扫描、STRM 生成、旁车文件复制、删除清理和 Emby 刷新。
